quiz.notes: Install the latest Lock In Launcher from https://github.com/hotpirateslocal/Lock-In-Quiz-Releases/releases/latest once to receive new Quiz updates. Launcher 1.0.4 adds Settings and a gear beside Download/Open. Choose default or per-app download/install folders, move the app, or move Quiz data to another drive on the same computer/account. Protected data is copied and verified before switching; interrupted moves can be retried. Close Quiz before moving it. Repair, open-folder, shortcut and uninstall controls are in app settings. Quiz 1.0.4 supplies the protected data-move helper. Install the new Launcher to use these controls. Required updates are checked before every Quiz start. Offline use has no expiry unless a required update is already known. Quiz and Launcher versions remain independent.
